task.title: Persist typed independent Verification outcomes
task.objective: Complete issue https://github.com/Knosence9/project-vela/issues/769 by storing explicit Passed or Failed evidence with one exact Attempt while preserving historical replay and lifecycle boundaries.
acceptance_criteria: Distinguish a successfully observed Failed result from checker execution failure.
Persist and replay typed outcomes with exact parent lineage while preserving payload versions 1 and 2 without fabricated outcomes.
Reject malformed structured Verification payloads and keep blank or execution-error results write-free.
Keep both outcomes evidence-only with no task or workflow transition authority.

attempts.summary: Established RED typed-outcome and compatibility coverage.
attempts.diagnostic: Focused verification tests failed because TaskVerificationResult, TaskVerificationOutcome, and projected verification outcomes did not exist.
attempts.patch: Added passed, failed, execution-error, malformed-payload, and historical payload replay tests.

attempts.diagnostic: A new payload version could carry outcome and evidence atomically while old payloads remained valid with no inferred typed result.
attempts.patch: Added the closed Passed/Failed taxonomy, structured verifier result, typed append path, strict replay validation, compatibility handling, ADR, and lifecycle documentation.

attempts.summary: Encoded valid append metadata combinations after substantive review.
attempts.diagnostic: Review found that the private append helper accepted kind, parent, and outcome independently, allowing a future internal caller to write a stream that only failed during replay.
attempts.patch: Replaced the loose parameter combination with an internal typed metadata representation that makes valid generic, parented, and structured-Verification append states explicit, then reran exact-head verification.

outcome.summary: Independent Verification now durably distinguishes Passed and Failed evidence from checker execution errors, fails closed on malformed structured payloads, and replays historical opaque observations without invented outcomes.

verification.command: nix develop --command cargo test --locked -p vela-kernel --test task_verification_runtime
nix develop --command cargo test --locked -p vela-kernel --test task_observations

lessons: A checker can execute successfully and report Failed; execution transport errors must not erase that semantic distinction.
Historical payloads should remain readable without fabricating evidence fields that were never recorded.
Authority-sensitive persistence helpers should encode valid field combinations structurally rather than depend on caller discipline.
